title: We Will Do Whatever You Ask Us To Do
content:
We Will Do Whatever You Ask Us To Do

Chapter 31 We will do whatever you ask us to do

Arthur was stunned, looking at the naive little boy, and felt happy in his heart.

As for the little things like peeing on his shoes, he didn't care.

It is very auspicious for a child to urinate.

He picked up the little boy, put his little head on his head and asked, "Little guy, what's your name?"

The little boy didn't answer and looked at him with brown eyes.

Arthur didn't care about this kind of thing, but someone did.

Gray-robed Amber hurriedly shouted: "Whose child is this? How dare you pee on the lord's shoes? Why don't you come over and clean your shoes?"

Several villagers also followed suit and scolded the little boy's parents.

A panicked young woman squeezed out of the crowd, her face full of apology and fear.

"I'm sorry, Lord Arthur, I'm sorry."

As he spoke, he bent down to clean Arthur's shoes.

"It's okay, it's okay." Arthur closed his feet so that the woman could not touch his shoes.

The woman was at a loss and muttered apologies.

But it was obvious that she was very uneasy with a little vibrato, because her child was still in Arthur's hands.

"It's okay. Doesn't this child have a name yet?"

The woman nodded and felt relieved after making sure that Arthur really didn't care.

"I think this bubble is quite accurate, which means that he is destined to me." Arthur teased the little boy, "Let me give him a name. Well... let's call him Arthur, the same name as me, to commemorate this bubble. Urine."

"Thank you, sir, thank you, sir." The woman thanked her repeatedly.

Arthur held the little boy to her, and the crowd around him suddenly burst into applause.

Most everyone had a better impression of Arthur.

"This is for you, it's very sweet, I tasted it." came a timid female voice.

Arthur felt someone tugging at his pant leg.

He pretended to look around, "Huh? Why can't you see anyone? Could it be the elves in the air?"

This move made the villagers laugh.

"Disgusting!" The female voice seemed a little angry.

Arthur then looked down and saw that it was a little girl holding up a peach that she had taken a bite of.

"Eat it, it's very sweet."

The girl insisted and handed it to him.

Village chief Jace squeezed in at this time, saw the peach that had been eaten, and shouted: "How can you give Lord Arthur a peach that he has eaten? You can't even come up with a whole peach?"

Arthur took it, took a bite, and said while chewing:

"Stop your ugly face. You, a village chief, are more vicious than me, a lord. Is that true?"

When Jace saw Arthur was angry, he immediately put on a flattering smile and tried to explain.

But Arthur didn't listen and bent down to praise the little girl's peach, which was really sweet.

The villagers were even happier when they saw Jace's embarrassed look.

Seeing that Arthur was so friendly to the people, they invited him to their homes one after another. Some asked Arthur to name their children, and some asked him to see a doctor.

Arthur refused all the guests, the one who named him did it on the spot, the one who treated the doctor...

Arthur really can't do this.

"Who were you treating before?" he asked curiously.

"There is no one. Sometimes I can see a doctor if I pass by a monk. But now I don't know how. The monks are all gone." Someone replied.

Arthur asked Jace: "Why didn't you tell me about this situation?"

Jess was stunned, "Isn't this normal? Why should I bother you?"

Arthur was deeply speechless about this village chief. The village chief's functions were not fulfilled at all and he only oppressed the common people.

When I had time, I found a reliable person and replaced him.

But Jess had the right idea. They had never had anyone see a doctor and they were used to it.

Arthur carefully recalled the memories of his previous life. It seemed that in the world of Game of Thrones, only in the north where the old gods were believed, there were bachelors from big families treating civilians.

Like Maester Luwin of Winterfell.

But in the south, where the Seven Gods are believed, there are only small monks treating civilians.

The bachelor's job was to see doctors and provide advice to the nobles.

To be more precise, he treated the nobles.

In Arthur's home castle, there are no maesters and ravens.

Of course, when the original owner got sick, he always went to Shili City to see a doctor. He didn't care about the condition of his subjects.

After the dog brother Sandor Clegane was defeated by the beauty, it was a kind monk who saved him.

This is also the reason why the High Sparrow, who was born as a monk in the later period, can control the wind and rain in King's Landing.

They take the mass line!

Arthur thought for a while and asked: "There must be a place nearby where you can pay for medical treatment, right?"

"Yes, they are available at the Beauty Market, but they are very expensive, one silver deer at a time, not including the cost of medicine."

If you can spend money, it will be easier.

Arthur waved his hand, "Then invite him to treat you."

Shili City earned 180 gold dragons, and Brynden received nearly 3,000 gold dragons from the incident. He is very rich now.

"But it's very expensive." Someone sighed.

"As long as it can make you healthy, what does it matter if I spend some money?" Arthur pretended a little.

He turned to Amber and said, "Remember to remind me about this and ask for the monk tomorrow."

Amber nodded.

The crowd suddenly cheered.

Seeing that the atmosphere was okay, Arthur expressed his thoughts.

"Well, I'm going to build a stronghold to defend against potential enemies."

Arthur didn't explicitly say it was the Magic Mountain.

Because no one would believe it.

"My lord, are you prepared to be wary of Crowtree City?"

"As Arthur says, we will do it."

"We will do whatever you ask us to do."

The villagers spoke out their thoughts.

Some people even speculated that the lord was on guard against the Blackwood family.

Seeing this, Arthur did not point out this statement and acquiesced.

The enthusiasm and support of the villagers exceeded his imagination, and the matter was settled.

What's more, it was still several months before the harvest, and there was not much work in the fields, so repairing the village would not delay things at all.

(The seasons in Game of Thrones are different from our four seasons. Summer can last for ten years. I don't know why Martin set it this way)

Amid the villagers' strong retention, Arthur and others left the riverside village and went to the next village.

The remaining eight villages were also similar, and they all strongly supported Arthur's decision.

In the evening, large pieces of fire clouds floated in the sky, and the twilight cast a beautiful filter on the earth.

Arthur and others rode horses in a sea of flowers and grass.

Looking at the picturesque scenery around him, he sighed: "My territory is so beautiful."

"It has always been like this." Amber said the right nonsense.

Arthur continued to sigh: "My people are also kind and lovely."

"They may be pretending."

Amber said in his heart, when the tax is collected, you will know whether they are really kind and lovely or fake.

Arthur ignored his words and continued to move himself: "I must protect them."

"This is what you should do." Amber insisted on echoing the lord's words.

His lord turned back and glared at him, "You'd better not interrupt me when I talk to myself."

Amber nodded aggrievedly.

Several people continued to move forward.

Before the night established a stable rule in the sky, they returned to the castle.
